blurb: Six Mile Lake Marina provides boat rental services charged by the foot with included local pickup, delivery, winterizing, shrink wrapping, and gear lubrication. They also offer maintenance services such as oil changes, hull acid washes, and battery charging. Storage is available in a locked compound with pickup and drop off during business hours.
